parameters.query: SELECT finalize_sends() AS r, d_config_json() AS cfg;
SELECT claim_delivery_batch() AS r, d_config_json() AS cfg;

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify(Object.assign({ sender: { name: $('Claim batch').first().json.cfg.sender_name, email: $('Claim batch').first().json.cfg.sender_email }, to: [{ email: $json.to }], subject: $json.subject, htmlContent: $json.html, headers: { 'List-Unsubscribe': '<' + $json.unsub + '>', 'List-Unsubscribe-Post': 'List-Unsubscribe=One-Click' }, tags: ['dispatch', 'issue-' + $json.issue_no] }, $('Claim batch').first().json.cfg.reply_to ? { replyTo: { email: $('Claim batch').first().json.cfg.reply_to } } : {})) }}
